paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Yostema and his two colleagues, Rav Huna bar Manoach (see there) and R. Shmuel bar Idi, died because they mocked Rav Pappa: Taanit, chapter 1, 9a, near the end. “Of Vastina” is a place-name, according to Rashi. Zevachim 112a has “of Yostina,” which Rashi explains as a place. He was regularly before Rava.
